preconditions.description: The length of the serial number is between 1 and 105.
The number of changes and checks combined is between 1 and 105.
The range of the change or check is within the bounds of the serial number.
The digit to which the range is changed is between 0 and 9.
The period to check is within the length of the substring.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' if the watch passed the check or 'NO' if it did not.
